page: Amazon Web Services c8id.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The platform is driven by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor delivering 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical cores at a sustained clock speed of 3.9 GHz. It features an extensive 480 MB L3 cache along with 256 GB of DDR5 system memory operating at 7 GHz, establishing a 2 GB per vCPU allocation designed for compute density. Architectural capabilities include Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for integer and tile operations, alongside AVX-512 instruction sets for vectorized calculations.

The server includes 7600 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage and delivers a 50 Gbps baseline networking capability. Synthetic and operational benchmarks position the platform in the top tier for multi-core throughput, including stress-ng parallel computation, PassMark CPU testing, and Clang compilation tasks. Memory bandwidth is similarly robust, demonstrating 393.15 GB/sec on large-block uncached read operations. Single-threaded performance sits within standard parameters, indicating that workload scaling relies predominantly on multi-threaded parallel execution across its 64 physical cores.

By coupling high-frequency compute resources with large-capacity local NVMe storage and high network throughput, this instance eliminates external disk latency for data-intensive processing. It is optimized for large-scale distributed caching services such as Redis, large software build pipelines, high-throughput web serving, parallel batch analytics, and CPU-driven matrix inference workloads.
description: Amazon Web Services c8id.32xlarge is a high-density, compute-optimized instance driven by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor on the Nitro hypervisor. It provides 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical cores running at 3.9 GHz, supported by 480 MB of L3 cache and 256 GB of DDR5 memory clocked at 7 GHz. Hardware acceleration covers AVX-512 and Intel AMX matrix extensions, contributing to top-tier benchmark scores in multi-core execution, software compilation, and cryptography. The platform integrates 7600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and 50 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, minimizing I/O bottlenecks without external storage dependencies. With a focused 2 GB of memory per core, this server delivers a cost-efficient resource density for parallel compute tasks, high-capacity in-memory key-value databases, distributed analytics engines, and static web serving pipelines.
